operations.raw_sql:
SELECT c.name AS contract, c.signed_on, c.contract_type, c.source,
          c.company, c.currency, c.agreed_price AS signed_sales_value
          FROM `tabSidra Sale Contract` c WHERE c.docstatus = 1 AND c.company = 'Example Homes'
      AND c.currency = 'USD' AND c.signed_on <= '2026-11-07'
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabSidra Contract Unit` cu
          WHERE cu.parent = c.name AND cu.parenttype = 'Sidra Sale Contract'
          AND cu.parentfield = 'units')
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM `tabSidra Contract Unit` cu
          LEFT JOIN `tabSidra Unit` u ON u.name = cu.unit
          LEFT JOIN `tabSidra Scheme` s ON s.name = u.scheme
          WHERE cu.parent = c.name AND cu.parenttype = 'Sidra Sale Contract'
          AND cu.parentfield = 'units'
          AND (u.name IS NULL OR s.name IS NULL OR u.company IS NULL
               OR u.company <> c.company OR s.company IS NULL
               OR s.company <> c.company OR u.scheme IN ('TEST-SCHEME')))
          AND c.signed_on >= '2026-11-01'

SELECT c.name AS contract, s.name AS scheme,
          s.scheme_name, u.name AS unit, c.signed_on, c.currency,
          cu.allocated_price AS allocated_sales_value
          FROM `tabSidra Sale Contract` c
          JOIN `tabSidra Contract Unit` cu ON cu.parent = c.name
            AND cu.parenttype = 'Sidra Sale Contract' AND cu.parentfield = 'units'
          JOIN `tabSidra Unit` u ON u.name = cu.unit
          JOIN `tabSidra Scheme` s ON s.name = u.scheme
          WHERE c.docstatus = 1 AND c.company = 'Example Homes'
      AND c.currency = 'USD' AND c.signed_on <= '2026-11-07'
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabSidra Contract Unit` cu
          WHERE cu.parent = c.name AND cu.parenttype = 'Sidra Sale Contract'
          AND cu.parentfield = 'units')
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM `tabSidra Contract Unit` cu
          LEFT JOIN `tabSidra Unit` u ON u.name = cu.unit
          LEFT JOIN `tabSidra Scheme` s ON s.name = u.scheme
          WHERE cu.parent = c.name AND cu.parenttype = 'Sidra Sale Contract'
          AND cu.parentfield = 'units'
          AND (u.name IS NULL OR s.name IS NULL OR u.company IS NULL
               OR u.company <> c.company OR s.company IS NULL
               OR s.company <> c.company OR u.scheme IN ('TEST-SCHEME'))) AND c.signed_on >= '2026-11-01'

SELECT u.name AS unit, s.name AS scheme, s.scheme_name,
          u.unit_type, u.status, u.offplan_status, u.delivery_date,
          u.company, 'USD' AS currency, 1 AS unit_count,
          CASE WHEN u.status = 'Available' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS available_count
          FROM `tabSidra Unit` u JOIN `tabSidra Scheme` s ON s.name = u.scheme
          JOIN `tabCompany` co ON co.name = u.company
          WHERE u.company = 'Example Homes' AND s.company = u.company
          AND co.default_currency = 'USD' AND u.scheme NOT IN ('TEST-SCHEME')

SELECT c.name AS contract, l.name AS schedule_row,
          l.seq, l.row_type, l.due_date, l.amount AS scheduled_amount,
          c.company, c.currency
          FROM `tabSidra Sale Contract` c
          JOIN `tabSidra Installment Line` l ON l.parent = c.name
            AND l.parenttype = 'Sidra Sale Contract' AND l.parentfield = 'schedule'
          WHERE c.docstatus = 1 AND c.company = 'Example Homes'
      AND c.currency = 'USD' AND c.signed_on <= '2026-11-07'
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabSidra Contract Unit` cu
          WHERE cu.parent = c.name AND cu.parenttype = 'Sidra Sale Contract'
          AND cu.parentfield = 'units')
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM `tabSidra Contract Unit` cu
          LEFT JOIN `tabSidra Unit` u ON u.name = cu.unit
          LEFT JOIN `tabSidra Scheme` s ON s.name = u.scheme
          WHERE cu.parent = c.name AND cu.parenttype = 'Sidra Sale Contract'
          AND cu.parentfield = 'units'
          AND (u.name IS NULL OR s.name IS NULL OR u.company IS NULL
               OR u.company <> c.company OR s.company IS NULL
               OR s.company <> c.company OR u.scheme IN ('TEST-SCHEME'))) AND c.contract_type = 'Installment'
          AND l.due_date >= '2026-11-08'
          AND l.due_date <= '2026-12-07'

SELECT j.name AS job, j.project, j.service_type,
          j.status AS job_status, st.name AS stage, st.stage_name,
          st.planned_end, st.actual_end, st.completion_pct,
          j.company, j.currency,
          CASE WHEN st.planned_end IS NOT NULL AND st.planned_end <> ''
            AND ((st.actual_end IS NOT NULL AND st.actual_end <> ''
                  AND st.actual_end > st.planned_end)
              OR ((st.actual_end IS NULL OR st.actual_end = '')
                  AND st.planned_end < '2026-11-07'
                  AND (st.completion_pct IS NULL OR st.completion_pct < 100)))
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS stage_date_exception
          FROM `tabSidra Construction Job` j
          JOIN `tabSidra Project Stage` st ON st.parent = j.name
            AND st.parenttype = 'Sidra Construction Job' AND st.parentfield = 'stages'
          WHERE j.company = 'Example Homes' AND j.currency = 'USD'
            AND j.status IN ('Contracted', 'In Progress', 'On Hold')

items.text:
Sidra Owner Overview — Example Homes

USD · Signed sales: 2026-11-01–2026-11-07. Inventory and stages: current records at query refresh. Date cutoffs are fixed; this is not a historical accounting snapshot.

Unavailable: cash collected, unpaid overdue balance, cash balance, forecast margin and collections targets. Receipt/allocation and approved Finance sources are not integrated. Scheduled dues are obligations before settlements, not expected receipts. Separately recorded down payments without due dates are outside this schedule.

Source queries retain record IDs for reconciliation. No automatic approvals or financial actions. Scheme labels are display names; reconcile by scheme ID. Charts have a 1,000-row/group limit; inspect full queries before relying on totals. Missing results are not proof of zero. Construction exceptions compare recorded dates; they do not certify an approved baseline.
